title: Platform Navigation Guide
description: Learn how to navigate the Tijraa platform, understand the dashboard layout, and find the features you need.
content:
Platform Navigation Guide

Understanding how to navigate Tijraa will help you work efficiently and find the features you need quickly.

Main Dashboard

The dashboard is your central hub when you log in. It provides:

  • Quick statistics and metrics
  • Recent activity overview
  • Quick access to common tasks
  • Store switcher (if you have multiple stores)

Main Navigation Menu

The left sidebar contains all main sections:

  • Dashboard: Overview and analytics
  • Stores: Manage all your stores
  • Products: Product management
  • Orders: Order management
  • Customers: Customer database
  • Categories: Product categories
  • Shipping: Shipping methods and zones
  • Coupon System: Discount codes
  • Blog: Blog management
  • Reviews: Product reviews and ratings
  • Analytics: Reports and insights
  • POS: Point of sale system
  • Settings: Platform settings

Store Switcher

If you have multiple stores, use the store switcher at the top to switch between them. Each store has its own:

  • Products
  • Orders
  • Customers
  • Settings

Top Navigation Bar

The top bar includes:

  • Notifications bell
  • User menu (profile, settings, logout)
  • Language switcher
  • Help and documentation links

Breadcrumbs

Breadcrumbs at the top of each page show your current location and allow quick navigation back to parent pages.

Search Functionality

Most listing pages include a search bar to quickly find specific items like products, orders, or customers.

Quick Actions

Many pages feature quick action buttons for common tasks like creating new products, processing orders, or adding categories.

Tips for Efficient Navigation

  • Use keyboard shortcuts where available
  • Bookmark frequently used pages
  • Use the search function instead of scrolling
  • Customize your dashboard widgets for quick access
meta_description: Learn how to navigate the Tijraa platform, understand the dashboard, sidebar menu, and find all features quickly.
